_readme: Area map: the single source of truth for issue-triage component labels.
block injected into the triage prompt) and validated by areas.test.js.
Per area: `key` (stable id), `label` (a comp:* label that MUST already exist
in the repo -- gh cannot create one and there is no label-sync), `definition`
Path resolution is startsWith with LAST MATCH WINS, so a carve-out must be
listed after the general prefix it narrows: web/ before web/src/components/
This fork collapses upstream's 35 areas into the coarser set a single
maintainer can act on, and adds four science areas for the omnisci layer.

areas.label: comp:infra
areas.definition: Repo automation and CI: GitHub Actions workflows, scripts, Dependabot, issue/PR templates.

areas.label: comp:infra
areas.definition: Deployment manifests, container images, and hosting configuration.

areas.label: comp:web-ui
areas.definition: The web UI: React app, shell, components, and its tests. Excludes the science workbench surfaces.

areas.label: comp:server
areas.definition: HTTP server, routes, host process, database, resource registry, and the client SDKs.

areas.label: comp:runner
areas.definition: Agent runner, runtime loop, session streaming, compaction, and OS-level sandboxes.

areas.label: comp:harnesses
areas.definition: Harness executors and their auth/model/tool bridges (claude, codex, cursor, gemini, kimi, goose, opencode, pi, qwen, copilot, kiro, hermes), the LLM clients, and the tool layer.

areas.label: comp:tui
areas.definition: Terminal surfaces and first-run setup: the REPL, terminal management, and onboarding/harness install.

areas.label: comp:policies
areas.definition: Policy engine, permission evaluation, and approval gating.

areas.label: comp:repr
areas.definition: Agent spec, skills resolution, persistence stores, and entity models.

areas.label: comp:science-core
areas.definition: The omnisci record layer: domain schemas, repository, ScienceService, storage providers, infrastructure config, the CLI/MCP facades, and the science HTTP route. Project identity, provenance, approvals, and export/import live here.

areas.label: comp:compute
areas.definition: Compute connectors and the connector contract: local, ssh, slurm, qsub, modal. Job submission, status reconciliation, logs, cancellation, staging, and output collection.

areas.label: comp:sci-skills
areas.definition: Science skills registry, install/lockfile machinery, and the bundled Science agent and reviewer.

areas.label: comp:workbench-ui
areas.definition: The science workbench UI: project panel and tabs, provenance settings, typed science client, and the CSV/JSON/Parquet artifact viewers.
